releaseNotes: v1.5.46: Centered organization logo watermark on digital pass, enlarged QR code with tap-to-zoom modal, pinned responsive Edit Profile sheet, fixed Firestore permissions for photo upload, seat requests, and notifications.

organization.name: The Cozy Corner Centre
organization.address: Front Of Reliance Fashion Factory, Nath Road, Parli-431515

studentFeatures.title: Larger QR Code & Instant Tap-to-Zoom
studentFeatures.description: Your pass QR code is now bigger, sharper, and can be tapped to open a full-screen high-contrast view for easy desk scanning.

studentFeatures.title: Pinned Edit Profile Dialog & Photo Upload
studentFeatures.description: The Edit Profile dialog now pins the Submit button cleanly above your keyboard and navigation bar. Updating your profile photo is instant and error-free.

studentFeatures.title: Instant Notifications & Seat Requests
studentFeatures.description: The Notifications Center and Seat Change request features now load seamlessly without any permission or access blocks.

studentFeatures.title: Centered Organization Logo Watermark
studentFeatures.description: The library watermark logo is now centered on the digital pass front and back, giving your smart pass an authentic, balanced look.

studentFeatures.title: Full Bottom Clearance & Easy Scrolling
studentFeatures.description: The help card and sign-out button now have generous bottom clearance so you can scroll every element completely above the navigation bar.

adminFeatures.title: High-Contrast Large QR Pass & Zoom Modal
adminFeatures.description: Student passes now feature an enlarged, crisp QR code with instant tap-to-zoom modal for rapid desk barcode scanner recognition in low-light environments.

adminFeatures.title: Hardened Firestore Security & Student Requests
adminFeatures.description: Refined Firestore security rules and scoped queries so students can update their profile photos, submit seat change requests, and view notifications with zero permission errors.

adminFeatures.title: Dead-Center 3D Organization Logo Watermark
adminFeatures.description: The library logo watermark is now positioned directly in the center of both the front and back of the student pass for a balanced, premium ID card appearance.

adminFeatures.title: Stable Student Profile Photos & Image Caching
adminFeatures.description: Eliminated profile photo blinking across student passes by caching decoded base64 images in memory and removing redundant 60 FPS animation loops.
